The room

One long room, lit warm

Leather pedicure chairs down one wall, manicure stations down the other, and amber pendants the whole way to the back.

Spa Nails sits in the strip along the highway, floral valance in the front window, the open sign facing the road. Towels rolled, polish racks full, someone at almost every table — it is a working salon, not a showroom.

The sets on this page are all theirs, photographed at the table and posted to their own listing.
